1) The arterial switch operation (ASO) is associated with an increased incidence of coronary complications compared to the Rastelli procedure; 2) Coronary complications after the ASO can be predicted by preoperative coronary anatomy, the need for coronary reimplantation and the presence of a ventricular septal defect; 3) The risk for coronary complications can be reduced by a more extensive reimplantation of the coronary arteries.
